findings.label: Lobulated tongue
findings.evidence: Bifid, lobulated tongue at 18 months with hamartomatous nodule. Intraoral photograph highlighting the bifid lobulated tongue and a pinkish nodule on the lateral surface, consistent with a hamartomatous lesion.

panels.rationale: Single intraoral clinical photo from OFD1 case report visibly shows bifid lobulated tongue with hamartomatous nodule, matching vocabulary finding for OFD1.
panels.attribution_text: Saygili and Kasimoglu. Dental and Craniofacial Findings in Early Childhood in Oral-Facial-Digital Syndrome Type 1: A Case Report.. Case reports in dentistry 2025. doi:10.1155/crid/8342997. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 3.
panels.figure_caption: Bifid, lobulated tongue at 18 months with hamartomatous nodule. Intraoral photograph highlighting the bifid lobulated tongue and a pinkish nodule on the lateral surface, consistent with a hamartomatous lesion. This presentation underscores the oral abnormalities associated with the patient's condition at this early age.
in_text_mentions: l arches, abnormal tooth positioning, a bifid lobulated tongue, normochromic to slightly pinkish nodule on the lateral surface of the tongue, and evidence of previous cleft palate surgery were noted (Figure 3). Periapical radiography was performed at this appointment (Figure 4). Although the upper primary central incisors were present, the lower incisors had not yet erupted.
